title: Build a 4-to-1 multiplexer
statement_md: Create a combinational module named `mux4to1` with four 1-bit data inputs `d0` to `d3`, a 2-bit select input `sel` and one output `y`. `sel` chooses which data input is forwarded to `y`.

ports.name: d0
ports.desc: Data input, chosen when sel is 0

ports.name: d1
ports.desc: Data input, chosen when sel is 1

ports.name: d2
ports.desc: Data input, chosen when sel is 2

ports.name: d3
ports.desc: Data input, chosen when sel is 3

tests.hint: sel=00 must route d0 to y.
sel=01 must route d1 to y.
sel=10 must route d2 to y.
sel=11 must route d3 to y. Check it is not swapped with sel=10.
If every data input is 0, y must be 0 regardless of sel.
If every data input is 1, y must be 1 regardless of sel.

hints: Treat sel as a number from 0 to 3 that picks one input.
A case statement or a nested conditional both work. Cover all four values.
Check that sel=2 and sel=3 are not swapped.
